mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in a month and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST shows a sustained increase over three months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% in a month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 70% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with low growth
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS shows a sustained increase over three months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 1% YoY, it signals a deflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth < 1% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.
